title: Senior Performance Engineer – CI/CD, DevOps & Quality Engineering
description:
**Job Title:** Senior Performance Engineer – CI/CD, DevOps & Quality Engineering

**Location:** Remote (India)  
**Job Type:** Full-time / Contract [select one]  
**Pay:** ₹1,20,000 – ₹1,30,000 per month  
**Experience:** 7+ years total, with 5+ years in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Senior Performance Engineer to lead performance engineering across our product and engineering teams. You will design and run performance testing strategies, find bottlenecks across applications, databases and infrastructure, and drive shift-left practices through CI/CD. You will also act as the performance engineering champion, influencing architecture decisions with data.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, volume and scalability tests
* Define and maintain performance testing frameworks, standards and best practices
* Analyze application, database, infrastructure and API bottlenecks and recommend optimizations
* Establish baselines, benchmarks, SLAs, SLOs and performance acceptance criteria
* Drive shift-left performance testing across the software development lifecycle
* Influence architectural decisions through data-driven performance recommendations
* Lead performance reviews and define performance maturity and continuous improvement roadmaps
* Define observability requirements and monitoring strategies, and analyze telemetry, logs, traces and application metrics
* Take part in design reviews, capacity planning and production readiness assessments
* Collaborate with Quality Engineering, Development, Architecture, Product, DevOps and Operations teams
* Communicate risks, findings and mitigation plans to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Mentor team members and share performance engineering knowledge

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 7+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering
* Hands-on experience with K6, JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, NeoLoad or equivalent tools
* Strong understanding of web applications, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems and cloud-native applications
* Strong SQL and database performance tuning skills
* Experience with CI/CD integration and shift-left performance testing
* Strong understanding of observability, telemetry, logs, traces and application metrics
* Experience with performance monitoring, dashboards and reporting
* Strong root cause analysis and performance optimization skills
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and technical presentation skills

**AI Fluency**

* Daily use of AI tools in engineering work, such as test design, script development, performance analysis, research and documentation
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated recommendations
* Understanding of responsible AI usage, governance and security considerations
* Willingness to experiment with emerging AI-driven engineering practices

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in enterprise SaaS environments and large-scale distributed systems
* Experience implementing performance engineering in Agile/DevOps organizations, or building a strategy from the ground up
* Knowledge of FinOps, cloud cost optimization and capacity forecasting
* ISTQB Performance Testing certification or equivalent
* Azure, AWS, Kubernetes or DevOps certifications
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field

**Additional Requirements**

* Background verification (BGV) and a valid UAN are required
* Available to work remotely with reliable internet and a suitable workspace

**How to Apply**  
Click "Apply Now" and upload your resume. Please mention your total experience, relevant performance engineering experience, current notice period and expected pay.

**Tips for posting on Indeed**

* Put the pay range in Indeed's salary field, set to "per month," so it shows in search.
* Add "Remote" in the location field so it appears in remote searches.
* Consider adding screening questions such as: "Years of experience with JMeter/K6/LoadRunner?", "Have you integrated performance tests into a CI/CD pipeline?", and "Are you available immediately?"
* If you want to hire only bench candidates, state that in your internal screening instead of in the public post.
* Add your company name and a short company description if you want more applicants. Anonymous posts tend to get fewer.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: AWS DevOps Engineer/ ( Trainer/ Faculty )
description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and experienced DevOps Trainer to join our growing team at Itvedant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in DevOps practices, tools, and cloud technologies. As a trainer, you will conduct interactive and hands-on training sessions, mentor learners, and prepare them for successful careers in DevOps and Cloud Engineering.

Roles & Responsibilities:

* Deliver engaging and interactive training sessions on DevOps concepts, tools, and methodologies.
* Provide practical training on tools such as Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, AWS/Azure/GCP, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Guide learners through real-world scenarios and projects, ensuring strong practical understanding.
* Evaluate learner performance through assessments, assignments, and project work.
* Mentor students with career guidance, interview preparation, and industry insights.
* Support learners with capstone projects aligned to industry standards.
* Continuously update course content to match the latest DevOps and cloud practices.

Job Qualification & Skill Set:

* Strong expertise in Version Control, CI/CD, Containerization, Configuration Management, IaC, and Cloud Platforms.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, AWS/Azure/GCP.
* 1+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or related roles.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and the software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts.
* Experience in guiding learners through hands-on labs, projects, and certifications.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.) is a plus.
* Certifications such as AWS DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes CKA/CKAD, Docker Certified Associate are preferred.
* Prior experience in training delivery (online/offline) is an advantage.

Pay: ₹700.00 - ₹1,000.00 per hour

Expected hours: 3.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
DevOps \& Infrastructure Engineer

**Company:** Mahatta Multimedia Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Hauz Khas, New Delhi  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Salary:** ₹6–7 LPA  
**Employment:** Full\-time

About the Role

Mahatta Multimedia Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a hands\-on **DevOps \& Infrastructure Engineer** to manage and support the infrastructure behind our digital platforms.

The role involves managing Linux servers, cloud infrastructure, Docker\-based applications, deployments, monitoring, backups, security, and production troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage Linux\-based production and staging servers.
* Manage cloud infrastructure and server configurations.
* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Docker containers.
* Support application deployments and basic CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitor infrastructure, applications, logs, and server health.
* Troubleshoot production and infrastructure issues.
* Manage backups, restoration, and basic disaster recovery.
* Handle SSH access, permissions, SSL certificates, and DNS.
* Apply security patches and maintain infrastructure documentation.
* Monitor infrastructure usage, capacity, and basic cost optimization.
* Work closely with developers and QA teams for deployments and troubleshooting.

Required Skills

* Linux Server Administration
* Cloud Infrastructure
* Docker
* Nginx and/or Apache
* Git
* Basic CI/CD
* SSH
* DNS \& SSL
* Backup \& Restoration
* Server Monitoring \& Log Analysis
* Production Troubleshooting
* Basic Networking
* Bash/Shell Scripting
* Basic Database Administration

Good to Have

* Python or Shell scripting
* GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar
* Redis
* CDN configuration
* Cloud cost optimization
* MySQL or similar databases

Candidate Requirements

* 2–4 years of relevant hands\-on DevOps/Infrastructure experience.
* Comfortable troubleshooting production environments independently.
* Strong problem\-solving and ownership skills.
* Able to work closely with development and engineering teams.
* **Candidates must be available for a face\-to\-face interview at our Hauz Khas, New Delhi office.**
* **Please apply only if you can attend the in\-person interview in Hauz Khas, Delhi.**

**Note:** This is a hands\-on infrastructure role and is **not** a desktop IT support, hardware technician, or office\-network administration role. Kubernetes and Terraform are not mandatory.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**  
We're hiring a hands\-on DevOps \& Infrastructure Engineer to run the infrastructure behind our digital platforms: IndiaPicture, MahattaArt and StudioIP. Your job is to keep production and staging environments stable, secure, monitored and recoverable.

*Please note: this is not a desktop IT support, hardware or office network role.*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Linux production and staging servers: health monitoring, upgrades and security patches
* Build, deploy and troubleshoot Docker\-based applications and their configurations
* Support deployments, basic CI/CD pipelines and rollback procedures alongside developers
* Monitor uptime, set up alerts, analyse logs and handle first\-level incident response
* Maintain automated backups and test that they restore
* Manage SSH access, permissions, SSL certificates and DNS/domain settings
* Document servers, deployments, backups, access controls and recovery procedures
* Track resource usage and capacity, and help keep cloud costs under control

**Required Skills**  
Linux administration, cloud hosting, Docker, Nginx/Apache, Git, basic CI/CD, SSH, DNS \& SSL, backup \& restore, server monitoring, log analysis, Bash scripting, basic networking, and database backups/basic DB administration.

**Good to Have**  
Python, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins, Redis, MySQL, CDN setup, APM tools, security hardening, cloud cost optimisation.

* Can handle routine infrastructure work on your own and stay calm when production breaks

* Work closely with developers and QA as a shared resource across the engineering team

**Apply now** if you want to own day\-to\-day infrastructure for growing digital products.

title: DevOps Application Support Engineer
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO** **SITA**

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.


You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward \- we’re proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work®** by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.


Are you ready to love your job?


The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ABOUT THE ROLE \& TEAM**  

As a **DevOps Application Support Engineer**, you will design, implement, maintain and support infrastructure/ application services in accordance with business and functional requirements using appropriate SITA standards policies and processes across multiple tools.  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**  

* Support DevOps Applications in accordance with agreed standards meeting the agreed technical and functional business requirements and specifications.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert for the supported applications.
* Manages supplier relationships and liaises with suppliers on problem\-solving and best practices.
* Participates in the full lifecycle of multiple small to medium projects ensuring the solution(s) developed can sustain the projects' functional and business requirements.
* Ensures all risks and issues that affect the project are raised following set processes and are actioned appropriately. Escalates risks and issues that pose a significant impact on deliverables.
* Ensures the integration of the requirements matches that of interacting systems applications and services both inside and outside of SITA in the wider airline community.


Qualifications:
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* At least 5 years’ experience in implementation or support of DevOps application deployments implementing systems and modules with experience in multiple full lifecycle implementations.
* Familiar with the operational support of applications, not one particular application
* Familiarity with synchronization tools (e.g. MFConnect, Tasktop) is desirable.
* Understanding of DevOps tools is required.
* More experience with tooling that supports the development process; tools like Azure DevOps, Azure Git, SonarQube, Octane(Value Edge). Generically Issue tracking, source code management, static analysis, quality management.
* Good problem\-solving skills, planning, teamwork and communication.
* Coordinate multiple technical streams of work to produce a complete solution.
* Understand the concept of IT security and its application to computer systems architecture.
* Sound knowledge of system integration, cloud infrastructure and hardware.
* Understand trade\-offs and risks with technical choices.
* Master’s degree or equivalent preferably in Computer Science Engineering Mathematics or similar\- where applicable a recognised professional certification is desirable.

 **WHAT WE OFFER**  

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development**: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!**Competitive Benefits**: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

 *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*
